in_sanskrit.name: चिदाकाश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The vast expanse of the sky, representing the infinite and boundless nature of consciousness and awareness.

in_hindi.name: चिदाकाश
in_hindi.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chid' (consciousness, awareness) and 'Aakaash' (sky, space). It could mean 'Sky of Consciousness' or 'Space of Awareness'. However, it is not a commonly used name in Hindi.
